arguments.value: A 72-year-old man developed behavioral changes, memory impairment, partial seizure, and worsening consciousness with inflammatory CSF findings. He was diagnosed with paraneoplastic anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis after CSF anti-NR1 antibody was detected and a left hilar lung mass with mediastinal lymph node involvement was found to be LCNEC with NR1 expression on immunohistochemistry. He was treated with corticosteroids, IVIG, and radiation therapy, with gradual improvement in neurologic symptoms and tumor shrinkage.
